Noida Schools Receive Bomb Threats, Investigations Underway

Multiple schools in Noida, including APJ, Step By Step, DPS GBN, JP, and Amity, received bomb threats, causing panic. Police and dog squads responded to the locations. Investigations into the calls, suspected to be hoaxes, have been initiated.
